definitions.explanation: A family unit living together or related by blood.
All members of a family together.

examples.japanese: {一家|いっか}に{一台|いちだい}は{必要|ひつよう}だ。
{田中|たなか}{一家|いっか}はとても{仲|なか}がいい。
examples.english: The Tanaka family gets along very well.

examples.japanese: {一家|いっか}を{支|ささ}えるために{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I'm working to support the family.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{一家|いっか}は{三|さん}{世代|せだい}で{暮|く}らしていて、おじいさんが{一番|いちばん}{元気|げんき}だ。
examples.english: His family lives together with three generations, and the grandfather is the most energetic.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}が{病気|びょうき}になってから、{母|はは}が{一人|ひとり}で{一家|いっか}を{支|ささ}えるようになった。
examples.english: After my father got sick, my mother started supporting the whole family by herself.

examples.japanese: {一家|いっか}で{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しをした。
{一家|いっか}{全員|ぜんいん}で{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}きました。
examples.english: The whole family went on a trip.

examples.japanese: {一家|いっか}そろって{食事|しょくじ}をする。
{正月|しょうがつ}は{一家|いっか}で{集|あつ}まって、おせち{料理|りょうり}を{食|た}べます。
examples.english: At New Year's, the whole family gathers and eats osechi cuisine.

examples.japanese: {一家|いっか}そろって{夕食|ゆうしょく}を{食|た}べるのは{久|ひさ}しぶりで、みんなとても{楽|たの}しそうだった。
examples.english: It had been a long time since the whole family ate dinner together, and everyone looked very happy.

notes:
{一家|いっか} refers to a family or household unit.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一家|いっか}{全員|ぜんいん} (the whole family)
- {一家|いっか}に{一台|いちだい} (one per household)
- {一家|いっか}の{主|あるじ}/{大黒柱|だいこくばしら} (head of household/breadwinner)

RELATED WORDS:
- {家族|かぞく}: family (general term)
- {一家|いっか}: family/household (as a unit)
- {世帯|せたい}: household (administrative term)
